messages:
anya-devex: Quick note — the JS quickstart in README is causing confusion. Snippet uses sync style but our SDK returns a Promise. New users paste it and get undefined logs.

lisa-docs: ouch, did support flag this?

sam-engineer: yes, just triaged a few issues. Also env var mismatch: README shows REDWOOD_KEY but examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY.

anya-devex: Proposed edit: use await + standardized env var.
```js
// recommended
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello' })
console.log(res.output)
```

omar-sdk: add a short Python equivalent and a note about streaming vs non-streaming responses. People paste non-streaming snippets expecting partial tokens.

anya-devex: will open PR and include a tiny examples CI job that runs the snippet with a mock client to catch drift.

ci-bot: docs preview ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/912 (expires in 24h)

lisa-docs: lgtm, thanks — added a line about not publishing keys in public gists. Closing once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
